subject: 📄 Contract Renewal — Action Required by $response_by
body:
Dear $staff_name,

Your current contract is approaching its end date. The renewal terms below have been prepared on the recommendation of your department; please review and confirm by $response_by.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
RENEWAL TERMS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Staff ID:           $staff_id
Department:         $department
Current Contract:   $current_contract_id (ends $current_end_date)
New Contract Type:  $new_contract_type
New Start Date:     $new_start_date
New End Date:       $new_end_date
FTE:                $fte
Salary / Grade:     $salary_grade
Decision Maker:     $decision_maker

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

NOTES FROM HR

$renewal_notes

HOW TO RESPOND

  • Accept: sign the renewal in the HR portal under My Contracts.
  • Negotiate: contact your line manager directly before $response_by.
  • Decline: complete the leaver form so your exit can be planned properly.

If no response is received by the deadline, the offer will lapse and your current contract will not be extended.

Kind regards,
Human Resources
